title: Problem: Can the meaning of evidentiary review evolve?
shortTitle: Problem: Can the meaning of evidentiary review evolve?
summary: The ADAPSO note asks how later convergence of review standards relates to the APA’s original understanding.
notes: Kenneth Culp Davis described a shift from treating substantial evidence and arbitrary-and-capricious review as materially different to treating their evidentiary demands as equivalent. The note asks whether a modern court may follow that later understanding if the original understanding differed. A response should separate the historical claim, the statutory text and structure, the role of precedent, and the institutional reasons for convergence. The question remains an interpretive problem in the assigned text.
